summary: The proposed patch addresses a KeyError in the migration autodetector when dealing with a custom ForeignKey field that removes the 'to' argument from its deconstructed kwargs. The change is minimal and appears safe, but additional testing and documentation could improve the PR.

issues.description: The PR includes a test case, but it would be beneficial to have more comprehensive tests covering various scenarios involving custom ForeignKey fields.
The PR does not include any documentation or comments explaining the change or the reasoning behind it.
